## 优化

- **桌面 TUN ⇄ 系统代理切换免重启**：内核已运行在系统服务中时，切换连接模式改为
  就地热切（一条运行时配置指令，秒级完成），不再整核停止重启——正在进行的下载、
  视频与长连接全部保留。仅「非服务态首次切入 TUN」仍需一次重启（要跨越系统
  权限边界，结构上不可省）。切换结果带回读校验，失败时界面与设置自动回滚。
- **「允许局域网连接」即时生效**：已连接时直接下发到运行中的内核，不再要求
  「下次连接生效」。
- **「连接时设置系统代理」即时生效**：连接中开关它会立刻设置/清除系统代理。
- **游客订阅同步改热重载**：同步后不再断开重连，配置就地生效；仅在热重载失败时
  才回退重启。
- **内核启动秒崩检测提速**：进程启动后不再固定盲等，改为即时监听退出事件——
  配置类启动失败的报错更快、且带上真实退出码。

## 兼容性

账号、订阅、协议、更新签名公钥、各平台升级身份均未改变。

notesEn:
Mode switching without dropping connections; settings apply instantly.

## Improved

- **Desktop TUN ⇄ system-proxy switching without a core restart**: when the core
  is already running inside the system service, switching the connection mode is
  now an in-place hot switch (one runtime config call, completes in about a
  second) instead of a full core stop/start — active downloads, streams and
  long-lived connections all survive. Only the first switch into TUN from a
  non-service session still restarts once (it has to cross the OS privilege
  boundary, which is structurally unavoidable). The switch verifies the actual
  runtime state and rolls the UI/settings back automatically on failure.
- **"Allow LAN connections" applies live**: while connected, the toggle is pushed
  straight to the running core — no more "takes effect on next connect".
- **"Set system proxy on connect" applies live**: flipping it mid-session now
  sets/clears the OS proxy immediately.
- **Guest subscription sync hot-reloads**: syncing no longer disconnects and
  reconnects; the new config applies in place, with a restart only as fallback.
- **Faster instant-crash detection on core start**: process startup no longer
  blind-waits; it listens for the exit event directly, so config-level startup
  failures report faster and with the real exit code.

## Compatibility

Accounts, subscriptions, protocols, update-signing keys, and per-platform upgrade
identities are unchanged. Core baseline mihomo v1.19.30 (matches the latest
upstream stable). Flutter 3.47.2 / Dart 3.13.2.
